title: The Ark
description:
S01 E04 — We Weren't Supposed to Be Awake
When their psyches are put to the test by hallucinations, the crew must race to find the cause.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E11 — And the Graffiti of the Gods
Graffiti starts coming to life and threatening a teenage girl; the team must figure out how these strange events relate to Gregor's Hammer and Gregor's imminent return.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E12 — And the Unfinished Business
General Gregor retrieves the Sword of Mars and uses it to take over the country of Caucasylvia, gaining control of their nuclear arsenal; the team must steal the Sword to prevent world calamity.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E01 — The Too Many Rembrandts Job
When the team comes together to help Sophie, they intercept guilt-ridden corporate fixer Harry and decide to help him take down an evil billionaire making money on the back of an opioid crisis.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E02 — The Panamanian Monkey Job
With a new team member on board, plus the arrival of Hardison's genius foster sister, the team heads to Panama to pull an elaborate heist before an evil billionaire can get his money and flee to a non-extradition country.

title: The Messenger
description:
S01 E01

description:

Flynn is excited to team up with his Librarian hero, Darrington Dare, to take down an ancient and powerful enemy let loose in the modern day; Darrington leaves the Librarians with a dire warning that there can only be one Librarian.

description:

description:

description:

description:
S02 E04 — The Fairy Godparents Job
A clinic is forced to close because its funds were lost in a Ponzi scheme; the team goes after a corrupt investment banker who has money hidden from the authorities.

description:
S02 E05 — The Three Days of the Hunter Job
A TV host claims a school-bus driver caused an accident that left two children dead; Sophie takes the lead as the team sets out to put the host in her place.

description:
S02 E06 — The Top Hat Job
The team tries to infiltrate a corporation responsible for putting tainted food on the market.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E07 — The Two Live Crew Job
The team must go up against a crew of thieves in order to retrieve a priceless artwork.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E08 — The Ice Man Job
Hardison acts as the inside man when the team goes after an unscrupulous diamond merchant.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E09 — The Lost Heir Job
The team tries to stop a corrupt lawyer from taking over his client's estate.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E10 — The Runway Job
The team infiltrates the fashion world to take down a sweatshop owner.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E11 — The Bottle Job
The team runs a high-tech version of a classic con in order to save a bar from a loan shark.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E12 — The Zanzibar Marketplace Job
The team has to work with Sterling to free Maggie from a Ukrainian jail.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E13 — The Future Job
A con man masquerades as a psychic medium in order to steal money from his clients.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E14 — The Three Strikes Job
The team runs into an unexpected complication while trying to take down a corrupt mayor.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E15 — The Maltese Falcon Job
Surrounded by FBI and with Sterling hot on their heels, the team decides to hide in plain sight, while continuing to take down the corrupt mayor and his gunrunning partner; Nate has a different endgame in mind for them all.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E01 — The Jailhouse Job
In order to save the life of an innocent inmate, Nate must bring down the corrupt warden of the prison where he is incarcerated and escape.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E02 — The Reunion Job
The team infiltrates the high school reunion of a software magnate who is involved with the Axis of Evil.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E03 — The Inside Job
When Parker is trapped in an unknown location while working a theft for her mentor, the team must race the clock to find and free her.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E04 — The Scheherazade Job
In order to rob a Boston vault, the team must time their heist to a nearby symphony concert.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E05 — The Double Blind Job
Nate and the team try to take down a corrupt CEO before he can release a drug that will kill thousands.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E06 — The Studio Job
In order to take down a corrupt record executive, the team must infiltrate the world of country and western music.
